aviation_incidents.headline: 10月13日路易斯安那州Cessna 210墜毀 飛行員受輕傷
aviation_incidents.summary: 一架Cessna 210於2026年10月13日在路易斯安那州Gonzales起飛後墜毀於Louisiana Regional Airport附近田地，機身倒置。引擎在撞地前脫離；74歲飛行員受輕傷，拒絕救護車送院，引擎脫離原因仍不明。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: Cessna 210 Crashes in Louisiana on October 13; Pilot Has Minor Injuries
aviation_incidents.summary_en: A Cessna 210 crashed in a field near Louisiana Regional Airport in Gonzales, Louisiana, on October 13, 2026, after taking off; the aircraft came to rest upside down. Its engine separated before impact. The 74-year-old pilot suffered minor injuries and declined ambulance transport. The cause of the engine separation remains unclear.

sources.name: AeroTime — Pilot survives Louisiana Cessna crash after engine falls off

aviation_incidents.headline: FAA推出MedGuide 供飛行員與航管人員查詢用藥及值勤等待時間
aviation_incidents.summary: FAA推出MedGuide線上指南，供美國飛行員與空中交通管制員查詢處方藥、非處方藥及用藥後返回值勤前的等待時間。首版僅列可使用藥物；指南不能取代個人醫療評估或醫師建議。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: FAA Launches MedGuide for Pilots and Air Traffic Controllers
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The FAA launched MedGuide, an online guide for US pilots and air traffic controllers to check medication information and waiting times before returning to duty. Its first version lists only medications categorized as allowed. The guide is not a substitute for an individual medical assessment or a doctor’s advice.

international_aviation.headline: 美國航空取消九條波音777航線 長程777-200ER服務改由其他機型執飛
international_aviation.summary: 美國航空取消九條涉及波音777的航線。長程777-200ER服務則改由夢幻客機與窄體客機執飛，報導將相關服務調整描述為機隊重整的一部分。
international_aviation.headline_en: American Airlines Cancels Nine Boeing 777 Routes
international_aviation.summary_en: American Airlines canceled nine routes involving Boeing 777 aircraft. Long-haul 777-200ER services shifted to Dreamliners and narrowbody aircraft as part of a fleet reshuffle.

sources.name: Simple Flying — American Airlines Cancels 9 Boeing 777 Routes: See Affected…

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空A350-1000將配置101個高端座位 長程策略轉向高票價與套房產品
international_aviation.summary: 達美航空A350-1000將配置101個高端座位。達美航空的長程策略也轉向較高票價、套房產品與忠誠度收入；報導未提供座位細項或其他營運調整。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta’s A350-1000 to Feature 101 Premium Seats
international_aviation.summary_en: Delta Air Lines’ A350-1000 will feature 101 premium seats. The airline is also shifting its long-haul strategy toward higher fares, suites and loyalty revenue; no further seat breakdown or separate operational change was specified.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Delta Air Lines' Next Widebody Will Carry 101 Premium Seats…

international_aviation.headline: 漢莎航空要求部分飛往法蘭克福的航班攜帶額外燃油
international_aviation.summary: 漢莎航空因對燃油供應的疑慮，要求部分飛往法蘭克福的航班攜帶額外燃油。報導另提及今年較早時因燃油價格危機削減航班，但未稱兩者有因果關係。
international_aviation.headline_en: Lufthansa Requires Extra Fuel on Some Frankfurt-Bound Flights
international_aviation.summary_en: Lufthansa has ordered some flights bound for Frankfurt to carry extra fuel over concerns about supply. The report also mentions earlier flight cuts driven by the fuel price crisis, but does not say those cuts caused the new instruction.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Lufthansa Orders Select Frankfurt-Bound Flights To Carry Ex…

international_aviation.headline: ACG確定訂購75架空中巴士A320neo系列客機 預定2032至2035年交付
international_aviation.summary: Aviation Capital Group（ACG）簽署75架空中巴士A320neo系列客機的確定訂單，預定於2032年至2035年間交付。空中巴士表示，這使ACG對該系列的歷史訂購總數達190架；合約包含轉換為系列其他機型的權利。
international_aviation.headline_en: ACG Places Firm Order for 75 Airbus A320neo Family Aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Aviation Capital Group signed a firm order for 75 Airbus A320neo Family aircraft, scheduled for delivery from 2032 to 2035. Airbus said the deal brings ACG’s historical orders for the family to 190 aircraft. The agreement includes conversion rights to other variants in the family.

international_aviation.headline: 俄羅斯多座機場10月15日至16日限制運作 航班恢復後仍有延誤
international_aviation.summary: 俄羅斯多座機場於2026年10月15日至16日限制運作，俄羅斯媒體稱共有22座機場受影響；莫斯科四座機場受到限制，聖彼得堡普爾科沃機場夜間暫停航班。運作其後恢復，但莫斯科伏努科沃、謝列梅捷沃及普爾科沃仍有後續延誤。
international_aviation.headline_en: Russian Airports Restrict Operations; Delays Remain After Service Resumes
international_aviation.summary_en: Several Russian airports restricted operations from October 15 to 16, 2026; Russian media reported 22 airports affected. Restrictions were reported at four Moscow airports, while St Petersburg’s Pulkovo suspended operations overnight. Services later resumed, but delays remained at Vnukovo, Sheremetyevo and Pulkovo.

international_aviation.headline: 達美航空與泰國航空最新商務艙產品將採用相同核心座椅
international_aviation.summary: 達美航空與泰國航空計畫在各自最新的商務艙產品中採用相同核心座椅。報導形容兩者將難以區分，並以未來式描述這項座椅安排。
international_aviation.headline_en: Delta and Thai Airways to Use the Same Core Business-Class Seat
international_aviation.summary_en: Delta Air Lines and Thai Airways plan to use the same core seat in their latest business-class products. The report describes the two products as difficult to distinguish and presents the shared-seat arrangement as a future development.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Delta Air Lines & Thai Airways Will Fly The Exact Same Busi…

new_information: Delta Air Lines and Thai Airways will incorporate the same core seat into their latest business-class products.
The source summary says the two are hard to tell apart.
